sn27.4:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Yo bhikkhave cakkhusamphassasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || Yo sotasamphassasmiṃ || Yo ghānasamphassasmiṃ || Yo jivhāsamphassasmiṃ || Yo kāyasamphassasmiṃ || Yo manosamphassasmiṃ chandarāgo cittasseso upakkileso || || Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno || pe || abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyesu dhammesūti || ||
